description: This file, resultsBugs.php, is a PHP script that is part of the TestLink open-source testing management tool. It generates a web page displaying bugs associated with test executions within a specific test plan and project, including integration with an issue tracker, debugging information, and table rendering. It includes functionality for fetching bug data, managing display settings, and user interaction.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class used for rendering a sortable, groupable extension table in the web interface

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class, used to assign variables and display templates in the Smarty templating engine

methods.name: buildBugString
methods.description: Retrieves links to bugs associated with a specific execution and updates open and resolved bug lists.

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Returns the column definitions for displaying bug data in a table.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns request parameters, including test plan and project IDs, user info, and display options.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has the necessary rights on the project for test plan metrics.
